_comment: Copy to mock-lti.json to work on the tool without launching it from Canvas. Read only when NODE_ENV=development and localCanvasDeveloperToken is set, and it fakes a session as if this user had just launched the tool in this course. The easiest way to get real values is to set debugLogging=true, launch from Canvas once and copy the launch body out of the log. mock-lti.json is gitignored; this example is not, so keep real ids out of it.
_comment_api_domain: The Canvas host the tool calls, honoured exactly as it would be from a real launch. Used as https://<domain>. Leave canvasBaseUri unset for this to take effect; canvasBaseUri overrides it.
